name: Nginx
author: JustArtiom@users.noreply.github.com
description: Runs an Nginx web server for static sites, PHP sites and reverse proxies, from uploaded files or a Git repository. The PHP images include PHP-FPM and Composer. Type help in the console for the reload and test commands.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

readonly WEB_ROOT=/mnt/server/www

log() {
    printf '[System] %s\n' "$1"
}

git_with_credentials() {
    local -a options=(-c "safe.directory=${WEB_ROOT}")

    if [[ -n "${GIT_TOKEN:-}" ]]; then
        options+=(
            -c credential.helper=
            -c 'credential.helper=!f() { echo "username=${GIT_USERNAME:-x-access-token}"; echo "password=${GIT_TOKEN}"; }; f'
        )
    fi

    git "${options[@]}" "$@"
}

mkdir -p "$WEB_ROOT"
cd "$WEB_ROOT"

if [[ -z "${GIT_ADDRESS:-}" ]]; then
    log 'No Git repository set. Upload your site to www, or set a Git repository and reinstall.'
    exit 0
fi

if [[ -d .git ]]; then
    log "Updating the existing checkout of ${GIT_ADDRESS}"
    if ! git_with_credentials pull --ff-only; then
        log 'Could not update the checkout, keeping the existing files.'
    fi
    exit 0
fi

if [[ -n "$(ls -A)" ]]; then
    log 'www already has files but no Git checkout, so nothing was cloned. Delete the files in www and reinstall to clone the repository.'
    exit 0
fi

clone_args=(clone --depth 1)
if [[ -n "${BRANCH:-}" ]]; then
    clone_args+=(--branch "$BRANCH")
fi

log "Cloning ${GIT_ADDRESS} into www"
if ! git_with_credentials "${clone_args[@]}" "$GIT_ADDRESS" .; then
    log 'Cloning failed. Check the repository address, the branch and the access token.'
    exit 1
fi

log 'Repository cloned into www. Composer dependencies are installed when the server starts.'

variables.name: Git repository
variables.description: HTTPS address of a Git repository to clone into www on install, for example https://github.com/you/your-site. Leave empty to upload files yourself.

variables.name: Git branch
variables.description: Branch to clone. Leave empty for the repository's default branch.

variables.name: Git username
variables.description: Username for a private repository. Leave empty for public repositories.

variables.name: Git access token
variables.description: Personal access token for a private repository. It is passed to Git when needed and never saved in the repository's files.

variables.name: Auto update
variables.description: Pull the latest commit into www every time the server starts.

variables.name: Install Composer dependencies
variables.description: On the PHP images, install the dependencies from www/composer.json when the server starts. Skipped when nothing changed since the last install; delete www/vendor to force a clean install.
